name: The Returning Bell
status: Published gameplay release; final public acceptance passed.
observedGameplayCoverage: A fresh launch selects the authored chapter and Xbox starts a scored saved expedition.
Down D-pad selects Blink directly; left D-pad returns to usable damage arrows.
Input-driven movement traverses the refuge, west stairs, gallery, tower, service descent and return passage.
Xbox reverses the winch screens without a menu and rendered positions agree with collision height.
Tracked stereo VR renders the same upper route and pausing cancels an actual two-controller draw without firing.
The checkpoint captures returning-bell-1 and its mechanism state.
The AR table uses immersive-ar, excludes undiscovered passages and pauses combat.
Tracked-controller and joint-pinch UI operate layers, recentering, information and session exit.
The table and complete menu fit both simulated eye views after recentering without changing head pose.
AR exit restores position, health, ammunition, chapter, enemies, pickups, score, shots and simulation time.
A real arrow rings the signal without a kill-all requirement.
The closed gate retains collision while its glazing reveals the surroundings.
The service-side latch opens the return route and the open state survives a real page reload.
Returning to the refuge completes the chapter once; a blessing continues into retained Endless with counters preserved.
The real public homepage card launches a moving, shooting game; the production board and workbook remain usable.
historicalFailures: The first publication attempt checked before GitHub Pages had served the release and failed its byte gate. Its gameplay steps were skipped and are not counted as passed. Artifact 10421086659 retains that attempt.
Concurrent sibling commits superseded earlier Pages deployments. Deployment run 35029924716 succeeded; the unchanged release was then retried and passed.

The earlier native First Bell lesson wait exceeded the software-renderer allowance. Recovery run 35025817895 completed the original lesson outcomes with bounded waits and timing records, without changing gameplay timing.

scopeAndLimits.software: Production WebGL with generated keyboard/Xbox input and simulated WebXR controllers and joints. Chapter acceptance does not assign player coordinates, enemy health, resources or progression to bypass the journey.
scopeAndLimits.content: One authored replacement opening is integrated and is the new-player default. The next authored chapter is not built; the blessing continues into retained Endless. This is a playable development slice, not a completed campaign or AAA certification.
scopeAndLimits.ar: Paused discovery-limited architectural inspection and retained stationary Sanctuary. No room scan, physical surface anchor, furniture occlusion, hand-only archery or playable third-person diorama is claimed.
scopeAndLimits.saves: Keep returning-bell-1 and hollow-dominions-1 immutable. Retain the legacy Surestep checkpoint fixture, existing profile keys, atomic reward receipts and legacy geography.
scopeAndLimits.openGates: Physical Quest 3 and Xbox testing, seated/standing reach, real hand tracking and passthrough legibility, sustained performance, comfort, unfamiliar-player/replay observations and finished art/audio remain open.

continuation: Read RETURNING-BELL.md and LEVEL-DESIGN-RESET.md. Tune this complete place from first/repeat-play observations before expanding the campaign. Do not restart the implementation or return to unrelated room-count expansion.
receiptChangeScope: This recovery commit adds only this evidence record under tests/evidence. It does not modify runtime, layout, controller mappings, saves, release metadata or the workbook. The gameplay release was already publicly verified; no new runtime release is implied.
